commander.name: Okoye, Dora Milaje Leader
commander.oracle:
When Okoye enters, create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
Attacking creature tokens you control have first strike.

oracle.Anointed Procession: If an effect would create one or more tokens under your control, it creates twice that many of those tokens instead.
oracle.Mondrak, Glory Dominus:
If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
{1}{W/P}{W/P}, Sacrifice two other artifacts and/or creatures: Put an indestructible counter on Mondrak. ({W/P} can be paid with either {W} or 2 life.)
oracle.Cathars' Crusade: Whenever a creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
oracle.Jazal Goldmane:
First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)
{3}{W}{W}: Attacking creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of attacking creatures.
oracle.Finale of Glory: Create X 2/2 white Soldier creature tokens with vigilance. If X is 10 or more, also create X 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance.
oracle.White Sun's Twilight: You gain X life. Create X 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This token can't block." If X is 5 or more, destroy all other creatures. (Players dealt combat damage by a creature with toxic 1 also get a poison counter.)
oracle.Secure the Wastes: Create X 1/1 white Warrior creature tokens.
oracle.Intangible Virtue: Creature tokens you control get +1/+1 and have vigilance.
oracle.Always Watching: Nontoken creatures you control get +1/+1 and have vigilance.
oracle.Luminarch Ascension:
At the beginning of each opponent's end step, if you didn't lose life this turn, you may put a quest counter on this enchantment. (Damage causes loss of life.)
{1}{W}: Create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying. Activate only if this enchantment has four or more quest counters on it.
oracle.Martial Coup: Create X 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens. If X is 5 or more, destroy all other creatures.
oracle.Reverent Hoplite: When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens equal to your devotion to white. (Each {W} in the mana costs of permanents you control counts toward your devotion to white.)
oracle.Heliod, Sun-Crowned:
Indestructible
As long as your devotion to white is less than five, Heliod isn't a creature.
Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or enchantment you control.
{1}{W}: Another target creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
oracle.Elspeth, Sun's Champion:
+1: Create three 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
−3: Destroy all creatures with power 4 or greater.
−7: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +2/+2 and have flying."
oracle.Flickerwisp:
Flying
When this creature enters, exile another target permanent. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
oracle.Restoration Angel:
Flash
Flying
When this creature enters, you may exile target non-Angel creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under your control.
oracle.Ephemerate:
Exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
Rebound (If you cast this spell from your hand, exile it as it resolves. At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.)
oracle.Cloudshift: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under your control.
oracle.Ghostway: Exile each creature you control. Return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
oracle.Conjurer's Closet: At the beginning of your end step, you may exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under your control.
oracle.Eldrazi Displacer:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
{2}{C}: Exile another target creature, then return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control. ({C} represents colorless mana.)
oracle.Teleportation Circle: At the beginning of your end step, exile up to one target artifact or creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
oracle.Semester's End: Exile any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers you control. At the beginning of the next end step, return each of them to the battlefield under its owner's control. Each of them enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature and an additional loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker.
oracle.Lae'zel's Acrobatics:
Exile all nontoken creatures you control, then roll a d20.
1—9 | Return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
10—20 | Return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control, then exile them again. Return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
oracle.Glorious Protector:
Flash
Flying
When this creature enters, you may exile any number of non-Angel creatures you control until this creature leaves the battlefield.
Foretell {2}{W}
oracle.Angel of Serenity:
Flying
When this creature enters, you may exile up to three other target creatures from the battlefield and/or creature cards from graveyards.
When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled cards to their owners' hands.
oracle.Court of Grace:
When this enchantment enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying. If you're the monarch, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying instead.
oracle.Eerie Interlude: Exile any number of target creatures you control. Return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
oracle.Otherworldly Journey: Exile target creature. At the beginning of the next end step, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
oracle.Okoye, Dora Milaje Leader:
When Okoye enters, create two 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens.
Attacking creature tokens you control have first strike.

description: **Core** : Okoye creates two 1/1 Soldier tokens on entry and every attacking token has first strike, so the plan is to multiply and pump that Soldier army.
**Engine** : Doublers like Anointed Procession and Mondrak double every token while lords Intangible Virtue, Always Watching and Benalish Marshal make the swarm hit harder.
**Payoff** : Spells like Finale of Glory and Secure the Wastes flood the board, then Jazal Goldmane's overrun turns the wide team into a lethal attack.
win: **First-strike swarm** : Okoye gives attacking tokens first strike, so your wide Soldier army fights first and sweeps past blockers.
**Overrun** : Jazal Goldmane gives attacking creatures +X/+X, turning dozens of tokens into a one-shot lethal swing.
**Emblem finish** : Elspeth, Sun's Champion's −7 gives your whole team +2/+2 and flying for a clean board-final attack.

description: **Core** : Okoye creates two Soldiers every time she enters, so the plan is to flicker her repeatedly to re-make tokens and reset her value.
**Engine** : Repeatable blinks like Teleportation Circle, Conjurer's Closet and Eldrazi Displacer re-trigger Okoye (and other enters-the-battlefield creatures) every turn.
**Payoff** : Instant flickers — Cloudshift, Ephemerate, Eerie Interlude — also dodge removal and save your board, turning blink into both value and protection.
win: **Re-entry value** : Each blink re-creates two Soldiers and re-triggers other enters-the-battlefield abilities for a growing army.
**Protect the board** : Instant-speed mass blinks like Eerie Interlude and Lae'zel's Acrobatics save your creatures from wipes and removal.
**Value blink** : Flickerwisp, Restoration Angel and Glorious Protector re-trigger your best ETB creatures for extra tokens and board impact.

quick_read: **Go-wide core** : Okoye makes two Soldiers on entry and gives attacking tokens first strike, so you flood the board with a wide, pumped army.
**Doublers** : Anointed Procession and Mondrak double every token while anthems like Intangible Virtue and Benalish Marshal pump them.
**Finishers** : Finale of Glory, White Sun's Twilight and Jazal Goldmane's overrun turn the swarm into a lethal first-strike attack.

Engines: Anointed Procession
**Token doubler** : It doubles every token you create, so Okoye's two Soldiers become four and every token spell goes twice as far.
Mondrak, Glory Dominus
**Doubler and shield** : It doubles token creation and can sacrifice two permanents to become indestructible, protecting your engine.
Cathars' Crusade
**Board pump** : Whenever a creature enters it puts a +1/+1 counter on every creature you control, snowballing each token that enters the battlefield.
Intangible Virtue
**Token lord** : Creature tokens get +1/+1 and vigilance, turning 1/1 Soldiers into resilient attackers that can also defend.
Always Watching
**Nontoken lord** : Nontoken creatures get +1/+1 and vigilance, boosting Okoye and your blink creatures while they attack.
Benalish Marshal
**Anthem** : Other creatures you control get +1/+1, a cheap global pump that makes the whole swarm hit harder.
Luminarch Ascension
**Angel engine** : Build quest counters by not taking damage, then pay {1}{W} for a 4/4 flying Angel each turn — blockers that double as a clock.
Reverent Hoplite
**Devotion maker** : On entry it creates 1/1 Human Soldiers equal to your devotion to white, which a white-heavy shell pushes high.
Heliod, Sun-Crowned
**Lifegain counters** : Gaining life puts a +1/+1 counter on a creature or enchantment, and you can grant lifelink to keep fueling it.
Teleportation Circle
**End-step blink** : Each end step it blinks an artifact or creature, re-triggering Okoye or a token maker every single turn.
Conjurer's Closet
**Repeatable blink** : At your end step it blinks a creature you control, re-triggering Okoye's two Soldiers each turn for free.
Eldrazi Displacer
**Repeatable blink** : Pay {2}{C} to flicker another creature, re-triggering Okoye or saving a key piece from removal.
Wincons: Jazal Goldmane
**Overrun** : For {3}{W}{W}, attacking creatures get +X/+X where X is the number of attackers — a lethal swing from a wide board.
Finale of Glory
**Army spell** : Create X 2/2 Soldiers with vigilance, or X 4/4 Angels too when X is 10+, flooding the board from nowhere.
White Sun's Twilight
**Tokens and sweep** : Make X Mites with toxic 1 and gain X life, and at X=5+ destroy all other creatures as a one-card wipe.
Elspeth, Sun's Champion
**Planeswalker finisher** : +1 makes three Soldiers, −3 destroys all power-4+ creatures, and −7 gives the team +2/+2 and flying.
Angel of Serenity
**Recursive removal** : On entry it exiles up to three creatures, and when it leaves they return to hands — blink it to repeat the removal.
Flex: Secure the Wastes
**Instant army** : Create X 1/1 Warriors at instant speed, ideal end-step attackers that trigger first strike from Okoye.
Flickerwisp
**Value flicker** : Flying, and on entry it blinks another permanent to re-trigger ETBs or reset a blocker.
Restoration Angel
**Flash blink** : Cast at instant speed to blink a non-Angel creature you control, re-triggering an entering ability.
Glorious Protector
**Flash guardian** : It exiles any number of non-Angel creatures until it leaves, protecting your board from a wipe.
CardAdvantage: **Monarch tokens** : You become the monarch; each upkeep create a Spirit — or a 4/4 Angel if still monarch — and draw a card.
Wipes: **Soldiers and sweep** : Make X 1/1 Soldiers, and if X is 5+ destroy all other creatures, leaving your own board intact.
Interaction: Cloudshift
**Cheap blink** : For {W} it blinks a creature, re-triggering Okoye and dodging removal at instant speed.
Ghostway
**Board flicker** : Exile your whole board and return it next end step, saving everything and re-triggering every ETB.
Ephemerate
**Recurring blink** : It blinks a creature for {W} and has rebound, giving you a second free blink on the next upkeep.
Eerie Interlude
**Team reset** : Blink any number of your creatures and return them next end step, protecting the whole board.
Semester's End
**Mass blink plus counters** : Blink creatures and planeswalkers, returning them with extra +1/+1 or loyalty counters.
Otherworldly Journey
**Blink with counter** : Blink one creature for {1}{W} and return it with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Lae'zel's Acrobatics
**D20 blink** : Exile all nontoken creatures, roll a d20, and on a 10+ blink them again for double triggers.

Engines: ⚙️ Engines / Synergies
Token doublers, anthems and repeatable blink pieces that form the core of Okoye's go-wide and flicker plans.
Wincons: 🏆 Wincons / Finishers
X-mana army spells and overruns that turn Okoye's first-strike token swarm into a winning attack.
Flex: 🎯 Flex / Personal Slots
Instant-speed token makers, flash blinkers and flexible pieces that adapt to the chosen game plan.
CardAdvantage: Monarch triggers and token/card engines that keep your hand and board stocked.
Wipes: Tokens-and-sweep spells that reset the board without clearing your own army.
Interaction: 🛡️ Interaction / Removal
Blink instants that double as protection, plus recursive removal to answer threats.

Tokens.combos_note: Okoye has no known Commander Spellbook combos — she is a low-data commander just breaking into the format, so his primer flags that honestly. Both of Okoye's plans win the fair way: the Tokens plan runs away with a wide, first-striking Soldier army backed by doublers and anthems, while the Blink plan re-enters Okoye (and other enters-the-battlefield creatures) to re-create tokens and grind out value. There are no infinite loops to assemble — the win comes from board presence and repeated triggers, not from a two-card kill.
Tokens.source_html:
• EDHREC : Okoye's page shows a low-data commander — only about 10 decks — with the emerging archetypes tagged Blink and Midrange.
  • Scryfall oracle : Every card is grounded in its current oracle text; Okoye herself creates two 1/1 white Soldier tokens on entry and grants attacking creature tokens first strike.
  • Design note : Because the deck pool is small, the Tokens and Blink plans are inferred from the commander's own abilities and the synergy scores of the included cards rather than from a deep sample.
  • No combos : Commander Spellbook lists no combos for Okoye, so the deck is built to win through token swarm and blink value rather than loops.
